C1471.title: V2X Road Test Triggers Emergency Braking Due to Ghost Vehicle Spoofed BSM Attack
C1471.summary: In August 2025, an autonomous driving pilot zone experienced a near-miss during V2X road testing when a test vehicle performed an emergency brake after receiving a Basic Safety Message (BSM) claiming a vehicle ahead was braking hard.
